MAKURDI accepts; (a) Two (2) 'A' Level passes in any of Chemistry and Biology/Agricultural Science/Botany/Zoology or Mathematics (Pure & Applied), Physics, Geology and Economics. (b) NCE/ND/HND credit/merit in Agriculture.
LAUTECH accepts; (a) Two (2) 'A' Level passes in any of Chemistry, Biology/Agricultural Science or Physics. (b) NCE/ND/HND credit/merit in Agriculture.

EBSU accepts a) two (2) 'A' level passes in Chemistry and Biology/Agricultural Science/Zoology or Physics/Mathematics/Economics. b) NCE with minimum merit passes in relevant subjects. c) HND and ND with minimum of upper credit in relevant programs.
